Name: AT Bikini Bottom Farm Buildings Beautification
Author: 996to627
Description:
What would the buildings in Birchburg look like in Starlight Valley?
Currently, the landscaping only includes the buildings shown in the picture, without any seasonal or grade changes!
————————————————————————————————————
How to use: Make sure to download SMAPI and alternative textures.
Download the mod, extract the file and place them in the mod folder.
After entering the game, find the carpenter Robin purchasing the paint bucket, and left-click on the house to use it.
————————————————————————————————
PS: Please do not upload the mod to any other website!
